title: Civilizaciones preincas: Caral, Chavín y Moche
goal: Investigate the millenary pre-Inca cultures: Caral's 5,000-year-old sacred city, Chavín's oracle, and the Lord of Sipán's gold regalia.
grammar: arqueología preincaica: Caral (3000 a. C.), oráculo de Chavín y orfebrería moche

items: Analyze Caral as the oldest independent American civilization.
Explore the acoustic architecture and feline deities of Chavín de Huántar.
Deploy archaeological, monumental, and metallurgical vocabulary (civilización, piramidal, oráculo, monolito).
